items.name: tooltip-001
items.title: Подсказка с клавиатуры
items.description: Подсказка, которая открывается и по наведению, и по фокусу с клавиатуры. Второе обычно забывают, и подсказка остаётся недоступной половине пользователей.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tooltip-001-*. Появление держат :hover и :focus-within у обёртки, поэтому JS не нужен и компонент остаётся серверным. Хвостик — повёрнутый квадрат того же цвета. Подсказка помечена role="tooltip" и имеет id: свяжите с ним триггер через aria-describedby. Без переданного children рисуется кнопка-заглушка — она нужна только для превью.

ai.usage:
<Tooltip001 id="copy-tip" tip="Скопировать ссылку на проект">
  <button type="button" aria-describedby="copy-tip">Скопировать</button>
</Tooltip001>
ai.summary: Подсказка вокруг любого триггера: появляется по наведению и по фокусу с клавиатуры, две стороны (сверху и снизу), хвостик на CSS. Держится на :hover и :focus-within, поэтому клиентского JS нет вовсе. Подсказка объявлена как role="tooltip" и связывается с триггером через aria-describedby. Ноль зависимостей, один файл, своя палитра.

внешние отступы через className

Не кладите в подсказку то, без чего интерфейс непонятен: подсказка не видна на телефоне, где нет наведения.
Не помещайте внутрь подсказки ссылки и кнопки: до них нельзя доехать курсором, она исчезает.
Триггер должен быть фокусируемым — кнопка или ссылка. У <span> подсказка не откроется с клавиатуры.
Не выносите CSS-переменные в globals.css: компонент обязан оставаться одним файлом.

en.description: A tooltip that opens on hover and on keyboard focus alike. The second half is usually forgotten, which leaves the hint unavailable to half the users.

ai.summary: A tooltip wrapped around any trigger: it opens on hover and on keyboard focus, sits above or below, and draws its tail in CSS. It rests on :hover and :focus-within, so there is no client JS at all. The bubble is role="tooltip" and links to the trigger through aria-describedby. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette.
preserve: the local --vibeui-tooltip-001-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens (bg-popover, text-popover-foreground and the like)
treating :hover and :focus-within as equals — a tooltip that does not open from the keyboard is unavailable
pointer-events:none on the bubble: otherwise it steals the cursor from the trigger
role="tooltip" and the id the trigger points at through aria-describedby
the tail as a rotated square with background:inherit — it takes the bubble's colour and never drifts from it
the transform-based offset rather than moving the position: that is what keeps the entrance from jumping
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the sides and the tail
the dark tooltip chip in both themes: it is an inverted chip, so it carries its own color-scheme branch rather than the page theme
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: tip — the hint text: one short phrase
children — your trigger: a button, an icon, a word in a sentence
side: top or bottom, depending on where there is room
open — force the bubble visible: onboarding, debugging, a showcase; leave it false in a normal interface
id — one per tooltip when a page has several
outer spacing through className
background — the colour of the bubble itself; empty keeps its own dark tone, and a light tone switches the text to dark on its own
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
Do not hide anything essential in a tooltip: it never appears on a phone, where there is no hover.
Do not put links or buttons inside: the pointer cannot reach them, the bubble disappears on the way.
The trigger has to be focusable — a button or a link. On a <span> the tooltip will not open from the keyboard.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
ai.usage:
<Tooltip001 id="copy-tip" tip="Copy the project link">
  <button type="button" aria-describedby="copy-tip">Copy</button>
</Tooltip001>

en.title: Keyboard Tooltip
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-tooltip-001-*. The appearance rests on :hover and :focus-within of the wrapper, so no JS is needed and the component stays a server one. The tail is a rotated square in the same colour. The bubble is marked role="tooltip" and has an id: link the trigger to it through aria-describedby. With no children passed, a placeholder button is drawn — it exists only for the preview.

items.name: tooltip-002
items.title: Своя против нативной
items.description: Сравнение на одном экране: слева кнопка с нативным title, справа своя подсказка — со стрелкой, мгновенная и доступная с клавиатуры.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tooltip-002-*. Серверный: обе подсказки держатся на :hover и :focus-within, JS не нужен. Левая ячейка намеренно оставлена нативной — атрибут title показывает системную подсказку через секунду с лишним, без стрелки и без реакции на Tab. Правая собрана вручную: хвостик — повёрнутый квадрат того же цвета, открытие продублировано фокусом, связь с кнопкой объявлена через aria-describedby.

ai.usage:
<Tooltip002
  tip="Скопировать ссылку"
  nativeLabel="Нативный title"
  customLabel="Своя подсказка"
/>

en.description: A side-by-side comparison: a button with the native title on the left, a custom tooltip on the right — arrowed, instant and reachable from the keyboard.

ai.summary: A demonstration of the difference between the title attribute and a custom tooltip. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.

On a phone the native cell shows nothing: that is part of the demonstration, not a bug.
The system tooltip delay is set by the operating system and cannot be changed from CSS.
Both tooltips show the same text on purpose — the mechanics are compared, not the wording.

ai.usage:
<Tooltip002
  tip="Copy link"
  nativeLabel="Native title"
  customLabel="Custom tooltip"
/>

en.title: Native Versus

props.note: The native tooltip never shows up on Tab and is unreadable on a phone. The custom one opens on hover and on focus alike — and looks the same on every system.

en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-tooltip-002-*. It is a server component: both tooltips rest on :hover and :focus-within, no JS is needed. The left cell is deliberately left native — the title attribute shows the system tooltip after a second or so, with no arrow and no reaction to Tab. The right one is assembled by hand: the tail is a rotated square in the same colour, the opening is duplicated by focus, and the link to the button is declared through aria-describedby.

items.name: tooltip-003
items.title: Подсказка с сочетанием
items.description: Подсказка, которая заодно учит горячей клавише: название действия слева, сочетание клавишами справа — она становится справочником, а не повтором подписи.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tooltip-003-*. Серверный: открытие держится на :hover и :focus-within. Клавиши нарисованы тегами <kbd> с полупрозрачной заливкой, а не текстом «Ctrl+K»: так их видно как клавиши. На кнопке стоит aria-keyshortcuts, поэтому сочетание доступно и без наведения, а группе клавиш дана словесная подпись через aria-label — иначе скринридер прочитает набор букв.

ai.usage: <Tooltip003 tip="Открыть поиск" keys={["Ctrl", "K"]} />
ai.summary: Подсказка с горячей клавишей: действие и сочетание в одной строке, клавиши размечены <kbd>. Ноль зависимостей, один файл, клиентского JS нет.

en.description: A tooltip that also teaches the shortcut: the action on the left, the key combination on the right — it becomes a reference rather than a repeat of the label.

ai.summary: A tooltip with a keyboard shortcut: action and combination on one line, keys marked up with <kbd>. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-tooltip-003-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
aria-keyshortcuts on the button: the combination must be available without hovering
the spoken label on the key group — otherwise a screen reader reads a run of separate letters
the <kbd> tags instead of a plain "Ctrl+K" string: keys are recognised by shape
opening on :focus-within — the tooltip must appear from the keyboard too
the dark tooltip chip in both themes: it is an inverted chip, so it carries its own color-scheme branch rather than the page theme
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: the action text through tip
the combination through keys — the array is drawn one key at a time
your own trigger through children instead of the default button
the key colour through the --vibeui-tooltip-003-key variable
triggerLabel — the caption of the placeholder button when no trigger of your own is passed
background — the colour of the bubble itself; empty keeps its own dark tone, and a light tone switches the text to dark on its own
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
macOS expects ⌘ and ⌥: substitute them yourself, the component does not detect the platform.
The combination in the tooltip must match the real handler — the component listens to nothing.
More than three keys in a row read poorly: long chords are better written out in words.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
ai.usage: <Tooltip003 tip="Open search" keys={["Ctrl", "K"]} />

en.title: Shortcut Tooltip
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-tooltip-003-*. It is a server component: the opening rests on :hover and :focus-within. The keys are drawn with <kbd> tags and a semi-transparent fill rather than as the text "Ctrl+K": that is what makes them look like keys. The button carries aria-keyshortcuts, so the combination is available without hovering, and the key group is given a spoken label through aria-label — otherwise a screen reader reads out a run of letters.

items.name: tooltip-004
items.title: Панель иконок
items.description: Панель иконок, где подсказка служит единственной подписью: у каждой кнопки своя доступная метка, а видимая подсказка привязана к своей ячейке.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tooltip-004-*. Серверный: открытие держится на :hover и :focus-within, но не у панели, а у ячейки — иначе наведение на панель раскрыло бы все подсказки разом. Панель объявлена role="toolbar", у каждой кнопки есть aria-label, а видимая подсказка помечена aria-hidden, чтобы имя не читалось дважды. Сторона всплытия переключается пропом side.

ai.usage:
<Tooltip004
  side="top"
  actions={[{ glyph: "↩", label: "Отменить действие" }]}
/>

en.description: A toolbar of icons where the tooltip is the only caption: every button carries its own accessible name and the visible tip belongs to its cell.

the aria-label on each button — an unnamed icon is never read aloud

role="toolbar" on the panel — that is how a group of buttons is announced as one
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: the toolbar contents through actions — a glyph and a caption per button
the side the tips appear on through side — top or bottom
the button size through width and height in the button rule
the tooltip colour through the --vibeui-tooltip-004-tip variable
toolbarLabel — the toolbar name for screen readers
background — the component background; empty means no background, taking the page colour

Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
ai.usage:
<Tooltip004

  actions={[{ glyph: "↩", label: "Undo" }]}
/>

en.title: Icon Toolbar
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-tooltip-004-*. It is a server component: the opening rests on :hover and :focus-within of the cell rather than of the panel — otherwise hovering the panel would open every tooltip at once. The panel is declared role="toolbar", every button has an aria-label, and the visible tooltip is marked aria-hidden so that the name is not read twice. The side it opens on is switched by the side prop.

items.name: tooltip-005
items.title: Подсказка с переносом
items.description: Подсказка для длинного объяснения: ограниченная ширина, выключка по левому краю и перенос по словам — строка на 400 пикселей не читается.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tooltip-005-*. Серверный: открытие держится на :hover и :focus-within. Предельная ширина живёт в переменной --vibeui-tooltip-005-width и дополнительно ограничена шириной окна, поэтому у края экрана подсказка сжимается, а не уезжает. Перенос собран из white-space:normal, overflow-wrap:anywhere и text-wrap:pretty — последняя строка не остаётся из одного слова. Триггер несёт собственную светлую подложку.

ai.usage:
<Tooltip005
  label="Как считается остаток"
  tip="Остаток — это оплаченный объём минус израсходованный."

the general sibling selector (~) between select and hint — both must be DOM siblings with no wrapper between them

the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

the value options through options

background — the component background; empty means no background, taking the page colour

en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-tooltip-016-*. It is a server component: the hint is bound to :focus-visible of the select itself through the general sibling selector (~) rather than to :focus-within of the wrapper. The browser marks focus on a select as "visible" only when it was reached by keyboard — a mouse click sets no such mark, so the hint opens exclusively while tabbing. For a text field this technique will not work: on text inputs focus is always "visible".
